mechanism: Carbamazepine is a potent CYP3A4 inducer that increases modafinil metabolism, reducing modafinil plasma concentrations and efficacy; modafinil may also inhibit CYP2C19, potentially affecting carbamazepine levels.
action: Monitor modafinil efficacy closely; consider modafinil dose increase or alternative wakefulness-promoting agent; monitor carbamazepine levels if modafinil is initiated or discontinued.
